title: Measurability of the tangential push-forward k-vector field for an arbitrary admissible L (measurability claim of parent step (c))
statement: Let P, Q, k ∈ ℕ, H^k := μHE[k] on ℝ^P, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, and let (M, θ, ξ) satisfy IsRectifiableTriple U k M θ ξ. Let f : ℝ^P → ℝ^Q be locally Lipschitz on U and let L : ℝ^P → L(ℝ^P, ℝ^Q) be any map (no measurability is assumed) such that for H^k-a.e. x ∈ M, for every linear subspace T_x that is a weighted approximate tangent space of (M, θ) at x (HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt k M θ x T_x) and every v ∈ T_x, the map t ↦ f(x + t v) has derivative L(x)v at t = 0. Then the k-vector field x ↦ L(x)_#ξ(x) = nVectorPushforward k (L x) (ξ x) is H^k⌞M-a.e. strongly measurable.
lean_statement: ∀ (P Q k : ℕ) (U M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) k) (f : Eucl P → Eucl Q) (L : Eucl P → (Eucl P →L[ℝ] Eucl Q)), IsOpen U → IsRectifiableTriple U k M θ ξ → LocallyLipschitzOn U f → (∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M), ∀ Tx : Submodule ℝ (Eucl P), HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt k M θ x Tx → ∀ v ∈ Tx, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => f (x + t • v)) (L x v) 0) → AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => nVectorPushforward k (L x) (ξ x)) ((μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M)
